Barcus Wroot is an unfortunate deep gnome searching for his friend,  Wulbren Bongle. He can be first be found tied to a windmill in the Blighted Village and can later become a Camp Follower.
“
Farewell. If we will meet again... well, then we will have met again.
„
— Barcus Wroot, bidding farewell to the party

Overview

Barcus Wroot is a deep gnome who lived in the Underdark with his good friend, Wulbren Bongle. Wulbren and Barcus eventually left, Wulbren to places unknown and Barcus to the city of Baldur's Gate. While in the city, Barcus found a bloodied amulet that he gave Wulbren before he left, compelling him to return to the Underdark in search of Wulbren. After rescuing Wulbren, the party can also learn that Barcus has very different ideas about how the Ironhand Gnomes should be handling Wulbren's rediscovery of the long lost formula to make Runepowder, a fabled explosive of tremendous power.

Involvement

Act One

Barcus is in the Blighted Village. Tied to a windmill, he is being harassed by a group of goblins led by  Fezzerk. The quest ⁠Rescue the Gnome is initiated upon approaching. If the goblins are defeated or convinced to leave, Barcus demands he be untied. To rescue Barcus, the party must pull the Brake lever inside the windmill. Pulling the Release lever shoots Barcus through the sky, with (predictably) fatal results.[1]

If Barcus is rescued, depending on the Race of the party member talking to him, he surrenders himself as a slave or asks the party what he can give them as a reward. He explains he is looking for a missing friend, and takes his leave. Party members with the  Folk Hero background gain the ⁠The Most Unfortunate Gnome inspiration.

If the party leave the Wilderness map before resolving the situation at the windmill, Barcus dies and his corpse is in the Blighted Village, as if the Release lever was used.

If Barcus survives his predicament, he journeys to Grymforge, and is enslaved by duergar led by  Nere. If he is freed again, he tells the party he is looking for his friend Wulbren, who was taken to Moonrise Towers. Barcus can be convinced to join the party at Camp as a Camp Follower on the way to Moonrise Towers.

If Barcus is in camp for the celebration after the liberation of the Emerald Grove (i.e., if the three goblin leaders are killed after rescuing Barcus from both the windmill and Grymforge), he can be persuaded to reluctantly set off some fireworks for the celebration.

Act Two

If Barcus is saved in Grymforge, he ultimately moves to the Last Light Inn as a Trader and sells the following items:

  • Acrobat Shoes
  • Gloves of the Automaton
  • Ring of Geniality

Upon completing ⁠Rescue Wulbren, he gifts the party the  Brilliant Retort. Speaking with both Barcus and Wulbren in the Last Light Inn after Wulbren is freed, reveals that both have different views of their relationship. While Barcus stills thinks that he and Wulbren are good friends, Wulbren does not reciprocate, and behaves rather coldly and dismissively towards Barcus.[2]

Act Three

Barcus travels with the rest of the Ironhand Gnomes to Angleiron's Cellar. He asks the party to not help Wulbren and asks that they spare the Gondians.

Later, if  Zanner Toobin and any other surviving Gondians are successfully freed from the Steel Watch Foundry, Barcus can be persuaded to lead the Ironhand Gnomes instead of Wulbren. If a  Persuasion check is passed, he is recruited for ⁠Gather Your Allies and grants all companions the action  Ironhand Grenadiers during the fight against the the Netherbrain.[3]

Speak with Dead

Barcus can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Barcus Wroot
      Barcus... he... called... me... Barcus...
  • What happened to you?
    • Barcus Wroot
      Caught... by... goblins... killed... in... fray...
  • Tell me about any valuables you have.
    • Barcus Wroot
      My... pack... everything... I needed... to find him...
  • How did you come here?
    • Barcus Wroot
      Left... the... Underdark... way home... nearby...
  • What were you doing here?
    • Barcus Wroot
      Find... him...
      • Who are you looking for?
        • Barcus Wroot
          Wulbren... my... Wulbren...
          • Why do you need to find this Wulbren?
            • Barcus Wroot
              Flame... in... the... dark... his amulet... found... bloodied...

„
— Barcus' romantic side

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Barcus' death from pulling the release leaver is scripted; the Feather Fall effect does not prevent his death if he is flung off the windmill.
  2. ↑ It is unclear if Barcus has romantic feelings for Wulbren or just care born feelings of friendship. There is no evidence either way in the game files or any statements from the developers.
  3. ↑ If the party attempt to stealthily kill Wulbren or any other gnome within his range of vision, Barcus always becomes hostile despite having exiled Wulbren in his first action as a leader. This also results in removing the Ironhand Gnomes from ⁠Gather Your Allies.
